description:
Why Do We Sneeze? The 100 MPH Nose Cleaner! — A tiny grain of black pepper lands inside your nostril, and ACHOO! Why does your sneeze blast out faster than a racing car?
Kids science answer for "why do we sneeze kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When dust or pepper tickles sensitive nerve endings in your nasal lining, your lungs compress and blast air out at up to 100 mph to clear the pipes.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
